business_summary: Qingdao Kingking Applied Chemistry Co., Ltd. engages in the producing and selling polymer matrix composite candle materials, daily-use candles, art glass products, and other handicrafts, and cosmetics in China and internationally. The company provides cosmetics products under the ALLL Beauty brand name. It sells its product through offline and online channel. Qingdao Kingking Applied Chemistry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Qingdao, China.
